versions.changelog:
Amazon Product Scraper 1.0.0

- Initial release of the Amazon Product Scraper skill.
- Scrapes comprehensive product information from Amazon listings using an internal browser.
- Extracts details such as title, price, reviews, BSR, descriptions, specs, and variants.
- Generates and saves a structured competitor analysis report in markdown format.
- Supports multiple trigger phrases and direct ASIN or URL input.
- Ensures all product text (including emojis and all description lines) is fully captured without omissions.
